 Exterior Painting 
Our exterior painting service epitomizes meticulous craftsmanship and unparalleled attention to detail, ensuring that every stroke enhances the curb appeal and longevity of your property. From thorough surface preparation to the selection of premium paints, we specialize in transforming exteriors into breathtaking works of art, with a commitment to quality that withstands the test of time. 
 Interior Painting 
Imbuing interiors with sophistication and charm, our interior painting service embodies a harmonious blend of precision and creativity. With a keen eye for detail, we meticulously prepare surfaces, select exquisite color palettes, and execute flawless finishes, elevating the ambiance of each room to luxurious heights while adhering to the highest standards of craftsmanship. 
 Cabinet Painting 
Our cabinet painting service is a testament to refinement and precision, where every brushstroke is a testament to our dedication to excellence. Whether refreshing the elegance of classic cabinetry or modernizing the allure of contemporary designs, we meticulously restore and revitalize cabinets to their pristine beauty, utilizing premium finishes and techniques that exude sophistication and durability. 
 Custom Painting 
With our custom painting service, we embark on a journey of ingenuity, where each project is a testament to our passion for beauty and attention to detail. We collaborate closely with clients to transform visions into reality, crafting unique masterpieces that reflect individuality and imbue spaces with unparalleled beauty and charm. 
 Millwork Painting 
Encompassing the artistry of millwork painting, our service embodies a seamless fusion of tradition and innovation, accentuating architectural elements with masterful precision. From intricate moldings to ornate woodwork, we meticulously enhance each detail, enriching the character and allure of spaces with bespoke finishes that epitomize craftsmanship and sophistication. 
 Drywall 
Our drywall painting service represents the pinnacle of precision and expertise, where flawless finishes and seamless transitions define our commitment to excellence. From surface preparation to final touches, we meticulously address imperfections, ensuring smooth and immaculate walls that serve as the perfect canvas for refined interior designs, reflecting our dedication to unparalleled quality and craftsmanship. 
 Deck & Fences 
Our deck and fence painting service exemplifies our commitment to preserving and enhancing outdoor spaces with uncompromising quality and attention to detail. From restoring weather-worn surfaces to applying protective finishes, we ensure that every element is meticulously treated, enhancing durability and aesthetics to create inviting outdoor sanctuaries that endure the test of time. 
 Commercial Painting 
At EA Pro Painters, we pride ourselves on offering comprehensive commercial painting services designed to meet every business's unique needs. From revitalizing exteriors to transforming interiors, our skilled team ensures your space reflects your brand's quality and professionalism. Our specialized offerings, including cabinet and millwork painting, cater to specific requirements, ensuring a custom fit for every project. We handle spaces of all sizes, guaranteeing a smooth, efficient, and tailored painting experience that elevates your commercial property's appearance and appeal. 
Learn more about our approach to commercial painting.

@graph.description: Request a free painting estimate from EA Pro Painters, serving Bellevue and the Eastside of King and Snohomish Counties.

mainEntity.name: What types of painting services do you offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide complete interior and exterior painting services for residential homes, HOA properties, and commercial buildings. Our team handles specialized projects including cabinet refinishing, millwork, drywall repair, and deck or fence staining.

mainEntity.name: How do I request and receive a free estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can submit your details directly through our online form or call us at 206-250-1194. Provide your contact info and project location, and our team will follow up—typically within one business day—to discuss your scope or schedule an on-site evaluation.

mainEntity.name: What factors go into calculating my estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Estimates are calculated based on overall square footage, surface preparation requirements, the condition of existing materials, paint selection, and job complexity—such as height access for exteriors or detailed millwork indoors.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured for residential & commercial painting work in Washington?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. EA Pro Painters is fully licensed and bonded in Washington State for residential and commercial painting contracts. Our Construction Contractor license no. is EAPROPP7611N. Verify any WA State contractor license here: https://secure.lni.wa.gov/verify/ Our UBI # is 604 324 084 Parent Co: E&A PRO FLOORING LLC Our Insurance Company is Trusura, policy # NRG-DBG-GL16326

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project timelines vary based on scope, home size, and weather conditions for exterior work. During your free estimate consultation, we provide a clear, tailored timeline before any work begins so you know exactly what to expect.

mainEntity.name: How do I request a commercial painting estimate from EA Pro Painters?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can request a free commercial painting estimate directly on our website by filling out the estimate form above (on this page) or by calling us at 206.250.1194. We typically respond within one business day.

mainEntity.name: How much should it cost to paint the interior of a 2,000 square foot house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full interior repaint of a 2,000 sq ft home typically runs $3,800 to $18,000 in this market — generally $3.00 to $7.00 per square foot of floor area for walls, ceilings, and trim. The variables that move it most are not the ones people expect. Trim and doors take far more labor per square foot than walls, so a home with extensive millwork prices well above a simple one. Ceilings add meaningfully. Color changes — particularly light over dark, or any strong color — often need an additional coat. And wall condition matters: patching, texture repair, and skim coating are separate from painting and should be itemized separately in any honest estimate.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint a 3 bedroom house interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most three-bedroom interiors run $3,200 to $6,500 for a full repaint including walls, ceilings, doors, and trim. Individual rooms typically run $600 to $1,200 each depending on size, ceiling height, and trim detail. If budget is a constraint, the highest-impact approach is rarely doing everything at once. Common areas and hallways carry most of the visual weight and take the most wear; bedrooms can follow later. We are happy to quote it in phases so you can sequence it against your own timeline rather than committing to the whole house at once.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out while you paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost never. We work room by room so you keep the majority of your home in use throughout, and modern low- and zero-VOC paints mean rooms are typically usable the same evening. It’s recommended you move out if we’re doing mill work or cabinets, or if we’re priming. We move and center furniture rather than asking you to empty rooms, cover everything remaining, protect floors on the full path from entry to work area, and clean up at the end of each day rather than only at the end of the project. Occupied homes are the normal case for us, not an accommodation. We do not move electronics or art; they are the responsibility of the owner.

mainEntity.name: What paint sheen should I use in each room?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reliable default: flat or matte on ceilings; low-sheen/matte or eggshell on walls in living areas and bedrooms; eggshell or satin in kitchens, bathrooms, and laundry rooms; semi-gloss on trim, doors, and cabinetry. The trade-off is straightforward — higher sheen cleans better and resists moisture, lower sheen hides wall imperfections better. In older Eastside homes with plaster or textured walls, dropping to a lower sheen on walls is often the difference between a surface that looks smooth and one where every flaw catches the light. In a bathroom, go the other way; moisture resistance wins.

mainEntity.name: How many coats do you apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two finish coats as standard, plus primer wherever it is needed — bare drywall, patched areas, stains, and any significant color change. One-coat coverage claims are a marketing position, not a specification. A single coat over an existing color leaves uneven sheen and inconsistent depth that becomes obvious in raking light. Any bid noticeably cheaper than the others is worth checking on this point specifically: ask how many finish coats are included and whether primer is separate. It is the most common place for a low bid to be low.

mainEntity.name: How much should it cost to paint the exterior of a 2,000 square foot house?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Puget Sound region, a 2,000 sq ft home typically runs $4,500 to $9,500. The range is wide because square footage is one of the weaker predictors of exterior cost. What actually drives it: siding material (cedar and older wood need substantially more prep than fiber cement or vinyl), number of stories and access difficulty, the amount of trim and architectural detail, how much of the existing coating is failing, and whether carpentry repair is needed once we wash and can see the substrate. A single-story fiber cement rambler and a two-story cedar home of identical square footage can differ by $4,000 on prep alone.

mainEntity.name: What time of year should you paint the exterior of your house?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Western Washington, May through October. Late June through early October is the most reliable stretch. The real constraints are surface temperature and moisture rather than the calendar. Most quality exterior coatings need surfaces above roughly 38°F through the full cure, which in our climate means the overnight low matters as much as the daytime high. Dew forming on a coating that has not cured causes surfactant leaching — streaky brown residue that homeowners read as a failed paint job. That is why we track dew point rather than just checking the forecast, and why we will push a start date rather than paint into a marginal night.

mainEntity.name: What is the proper way to paint a house exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparation is the job; the paint is the easy part. A correct exterior sequence is: pressure wash to remove dirt, chalk, mildew, and loose material, then allow full dry time — typically 24 to 48 hours here, longer in shaded areas. Scrape and sand all failing coating to a sound edge. Make carpentry repairs and replace rotted trim or siding. Caulk joints, gaps, and end grain with a quality elastomeric sealant. Spot-prime all bare wood and any stains that would bleed through. Then apply two full coats of quality 100% acrylic coating. The steps most often skipped when a bid comes in low are dry time, spot priming, and caulking. All three are invisible on the day the crew leaves and all three determine whether the finish lasts eight years or fifteen. If one bid is dramatically cheaper than the others, the difference is almost always here — ask each bidder to specify their prep sequence in writing and compare those, not the totals.

mainEntity.name: How often does a house need repainting in the Puget Sound area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seven to twelve years for most homes here, though that average conceals a lot of variation. South- and west-facing elevations take the most UV and weather and commonly need attention several years before the rest of the house. Our climate is hard on coatings in a specific way: sustained damp rather than extreme heat. Persistent moisture drives mildew growth and, on wood siding, wood rot behind any coating breach. Watch for chalking that transfers to your hand, hairline checking, caulk separating at trim joints, and any bare wood. Addressing those is maintenance. Waiting until siding is compromised converts a paint project into a carpentry project at several times the cost. Certain colors (like Navy blue and bright red) may need to be re-painted sooner than a neutral color

mainEntity.name: What happens if it rains during my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stop, cover, and resume when conditions allow — and you are told the same day rather than left guessing. Rain on an uncured coating causes real problems: washout, surfactant leaching, and adhesion failure. This is why we build weather contingency into the schedule rather than promising dates the Pacific Northwest cannot support. A contractor who guarantees an exact completion date for exterior work in this region is either padding heavily or planning to paint in conditions they should not.

mainEntity.name: What do commercial painters charge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial interior work in the Seattle metro typically runs $1.50 to $4.00 per square foot, with exteriors quoted per project after a site assessment. Commercial pricing works differently from residential in a way that catches owners out: the controlling variables are access, scheduling, and surface condition rather than square footage. A 10,000 sq ft warehouse with open floor and clear walls can price lower per foot than a 4,000 sq ft occupied office suite requiring evening work, furniture protection, and phased access. When you compare bids, compare the assumptions about access and hours — that is usually where the difference is.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a commercial painter and an industrial painter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial painting covers occupied and public-facing buildings — offices, retail, medical suites, schools, multi-family and common areas. The priorities are appearance, durability under traffic, low odor and fast return-to-service, and working around occupants. Industrial painting covers manufacturing and infrastructure — structural steel, tanks, plants, containment coatings. It involves specialized surface preparation, protective coating systems, and safety and environmental requirements well beyond commercial work. EA Pro Painters is a commercial painting contractor. If your project is genuinely industrial, we will tell you so and point you toward a specialist rather than take work we are not the right fit for.

mainEntity.name: Can you work outside our business hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and for most occupied commercial spaces we recommend it. Evening, overnight, and weekend scheduling means your staff and customers never work around equipment, and you avoid the productivity cost of a disrupted floor. We also specify low- and zero-VOC coatings for occupied interiors so spaces are usable the following morning without lingering odor — which matters especially in medical, dental, childcare, and food service environments.

mainEntity.name: Do you carry the insurance and bonding our property management company requires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We maintain general liability, workers' compensation, and bonding, and we issue certificates of insurance naming your entity as additional insured on request — which most property managers and commercial landlords require before a crew is allowed on site. Send us your insurance requirements with the RFP and we will confirm compliance before bidding rather than discovering a gap after award.

mainEntity.name: How do you minimize disruption in an occupied building?

acceptedAnswer.text: By phasing. We break the project into zones so only a defined area is out of service at any point, protect and relocate furnishings within each zone, and restore each zone to working condition before moving to the next. You get a written phase schedule before we start, a single point of contact for the duration, and daily end-of-shift cleanup — so the space is presentable every morning regardless of where the project stands.

mainEntity.name: Is it cheaper to paint or replace kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting is dramatically cheaper — typically $3,000 to $7,000 for a standard kitchen versus $15,000 to $40,000+ for replacement. For most kitchens, painting delivers the large majority of the visual change at a fraction of the cost and in about a week instead of a month. The honest qualifier: painting only makes sense if the boxes are structurally sound. If doors are delaminating, boxes are sagging, particleboard has swollen from water damage, or the layout itself does not work, paint is money spent on a problem it cannot fix. Solid wood, plywood, and sound MDF doors take paint extremely well. We will tell you during the walkthrough which situation you are in, including when the answer is that you should replace rather than hire us.

mainEntity.name: Is professional cabinet painting worth it, or can I do it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinets are the single hardest interior painting job to do well, and the gap between a professional and a DIY result is more visible than on any other surface. Cabinets get touched constantly, sit at eye level, and show every brush mark under kitchen lighting. The difference is method rather than skill alone. A professional cabinet finish means full degreasing, de-glossing or sanding, a bonding primer specified for the substrate, and sprayed topcoats in a controlled setup — usually with doors removed, labeled, and finished off-site on racks. Brushing and rolling cabinets leaves texture that reads as amateur immediately, and skipping the degreasing step on a kitchen means the finish will peel at the handles within a year no matter how good the paint was.

mainEntity.name: What is the downside to painting kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three real ones, and any contractor who tells you there are none is selling. First, painted cabinets are less forgiving of impact than stained wood — chips show as a bright spot rather than blending, though touch-up is straightforward if you keep the leftover paint. Second, the process takes about a week during which your kitchen is partly out of service. Third, it is not reversible in practice; returning to natural wood later means stripping, which is expensive and rarely fully successful. What is not a real downside, if the work is done properly: durability. A correctly prepped and sprayed cabinet finish holds up for years of daily use. Nearly every horror story about peeling cabinets traces back to skipped degreasing or a primer that was never specified for the substrate.

mainEntity.name: How much does Home Depot charge to paint kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Big-box cabinet refinishing programs generally quote $4,000 to $10,000 for a standard kitchen. The work is subcontracted to a third-party crew rather than performed by the retailer. [Include link] The thing worth comparing is not the headline price but who stands behind the finish and what the process actually is. Ask any bidder — including us — three questions: are doors removed and sprayed, or finished in place with a brush? What primer is specified, and why that one for these cabinets? Who honors the warranty in two years, the retailer or the sub? The answers separate the bids far more reliably than the number does.

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet painting take, and can I use my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six to eight working days for a typical kitchen. Day one is removal, labeling, and degreasing; the middle days are prep and spray on doors and drawer fronts while boxes are finished in place; the final day is reinstallation and hardware. You keep partial use throughout. Appliances, sink, and counters stay available — you lose cabinet storage while doors are off, so we suggest setting out what you need daily before we start. We contain and ventilate the work area and use low-VOC finishes, so the kitchen stays usable rather than uninhabitable.

Cabinet Painting Services - Kitchen & Bathroom Transformations
Professional Painting: Expert Cabinet Services 




If your kitchen is starting to look dull and lifeless, you don’t need to embark on a major renovation project immediately and waste time, lots of money, and mental energy. Sometimes, a fresh coat of paint on the kitchen cabinets is all you need to transform your space from drab to fab. 




With EA Pro Painters, you can pump life back into your kitchen one paint coating at a time. Our comprehensive cabinet painting services ensure luxurious, high-quality work without costly prices. Ready to transform your cabinets? Get your free cabinet painting estimate today. 




Get A Free Estimate 
Give Your Cabinets a Fresh New Look  


Think about the time you visited a friend’s kitchen or a kitchen furniture showroom. What did you immediately notice? You may not realize it, but cabinets are one of the first items people look at when they enter a kitchen. 




Many people overlook the visual impact of cabinets, but they are more than just a functional storage solution. Cabinets take up most of the space in your kitchen, so it makes sense to invest in making them look fresh all the time. 

Our Work

Save More When You Repaint  

A repaint is much more cost-effective than a complete kitchen overhaul; most of the time, a kitchen cabinet door repaint is enough to give your space a crisp, new appearance. With the right colors, you can even change the aesthetic elevating your kitchen from a mess hall to more lively or gourmet space. 


We Don’t Just Do Kitchens  


Your kitchen is not the only place filled with cabinets. Your office, pantry, workspaces, stores, and more also rely on cabinets for efficient and practical storage. 




Refreshing your cabinets every few years gives your commercial or professional space a sharp look to keep your employees motivated to work and ensure customer satisfaction with their shopping experience. 


Elevate Aesthetic and Home Value  


If you bought a home that doesn’t match your vibe, repainting your cabinets is a quick way to change its appearance and test-drive your aesthetic to see if it fits your new house. 




Repainting or updating the colors of your cabinets is also a simple way to increase your home’s value. You may not be aware of it, but every slight improvement you make to your home adds up and eventually increases its market and perceived value.

Let’s Make Your Cabinets Look Good - Benefits of Professional Painters 


Repainting cabinets might sound like a simple job that you can do yourself. While there are many video tutorials online on cabinet painting, you can only see and experience a level of finesse when working with professionals. 




At EA Pro Painters, our professional interior and exterior painting contractors are equipped with years of experience and high-quality materials to give your cabinets a fresh new look. 


Precision in Every Stroke  


Painting requires technical mastery. You should pay detailed attention to every stroke to achieve a professional finish. 




Our professional home and commercial painters have worked on a wide range of projects for Seattle area home and business owners to give their places a pop of color. With our skilled painters’ expertise, your cabinets will look like they just came out of the store. Perfection down to the tiniest detail. 




Expert Color Consultation  

Deciding the color of your cabinet takes more time than you might think, especially if you have no idea what you want or what will work with your space. Choosing the right color can create visual harmony in your house or indoor space. 




Our expert painters at EA Pro Painters can help you narrow your choices and find the perfect cabinet color for your room. We’ll conduct a thorough interview to understand your preferred aesthetic, space, and budget, as well as test-run samples to find the “one.” 

Top-notch Paint Quality


Sometimes, you can tell the outcome of a paint job even before it starts by the quality of your chosen paint brand. Not all types of paint are formulated the same. Some might take more time to dry, while other brands might apply easily but don’t leave a smooth finish. 




Our collection of professional-grade paints at EA Pro Painters always ensures a sleek and flawless finish. You won’t have to worry about chipping after a year from the application because our paint is made with durability in mind. 


Is it cheaper to paint or replace kitchen cabinets?

Painting is dramatically cheaper — typically $3,000 to $7,000 for a standard kitchen versus $15,000 to $40,000+ for replacement. For most kitchens, painting delivers the large majority of the visual change at a fraction of the cost and in about a week instead of a month. 




The honest qualifier: painting only makes sense if the boxes are structurally sound. If doors are delaminating, boxes are sagging, particleboard has swollen from water damage, or the layout itself does not work, paint is money spent on a problem it cannot fix. Solid wood, plywood, and sound MDF doors take paint extremely well. We will tell you during the walkthrough which situation you are in, including when the answer is that you should replace rather than hire us. 

Is professional cabinet painting worth it, or can I do it myself?

Cabinets are the single hardest interior painting job to do well, and the gap between a professional and a DIY result is more visible than on any other surface. Cabinets get touched constantly, sit at eye level, and show every brush mark under kitchen lighting. 




The difference is method rather than skill alone. A professional cabinet finish means full degreasing, de-glossing or sanding, a bonding primer specified for the substrate, and sprayed topcoats in a controlled setup — usually with doors removed, labeled, and finished off-site on racks. Brushing and rolling cabinets leaves texture that reads as amateur immediately, and skipping the degreasing step on a kitchen means the finish will peel at the handles within a year no matter how good the paint was.

How long does cabinet painting take, and can I use my kitchen?

Six to eight working days for a typical kitchen. Day one is removal, labeling, and degreasing; the middle days are prep and spray on doors and drawer fronts while boxes are finished in place; the final day is reinstallation and hardware. 




You keep partial use throughout. Appliances, sink, and counters stay available — you lose cabinet storage while doors are off, so we suggest setting out what you need daily before we start. We contain and ventilate the work area and use low-VOC finishes, so the kitchen stays usable rather than uninhabitable.

Standard-painted walls are fine, but if you want the paint on your surfaces to really reflect your tastes, there’s very little that typical colors can accomplish. For a more personalized and professional finish, choose custom work with professional painters who can bring your vision to life — us. 




At EA Pro Painters, we provide custom professional painting services to homeowners and businesses in the Greater Seattle Area. As your local painting pros, we’re here to transform your surfaces into a canvas that reflects your personal style. 




Look no further for bespoke painting services that refresh and revitalize your home or business. Contact us at EA Pro Painters today for a free quote on our custom painting services. We are committed to ensuring customer satisfaction through personalized consultations and meticulous attention to detail.

What Is Custom Painting?  

Unlike standardized painting, custom painting is about crafting a unique look tailored to your taste, space, and needs. A fresh coat of paint can rejuvenate and brighten your space, offering both aesthetic benefits and protective qualities for your home's interior. Custom painting services give you the freedom to design a look that reflects your style, whether you want a bold statement wall in your living room, a calming color scheme for a bedroom, or a revamped office space. 




When you choose a custom painting company like EA Pro Painters, you get more than just a new coat of paint. You’re also in for a customized experience and surface finishes that add value and character to your Washington property. Our passion for the details and craftsmanship ensures exceptional results that exceed client expectations. 


Why Your Home or Business Needs Custom Painting Services  


Custom painting is an investment in your home or business for a wide range of reasons. Besides elevating your business or home’s curb appeal, there are numerous benefits to hiring a custom painting company. 




Here’s what you can look forward to when you choose EA Pro Painters to handle your painting projects in Washington: 




Personalization: Custom painting allows you to completely control the color, texture, and finish, making the result utterly unique. 
Increased Property Value: Quality custom painting can boost your property’s curb appeal and value and make it more attractive to prospective buyers or clients. 
Enhanced Mood and Productivity: Are you a business owner in Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland, or nearby areas? Custom painting can create an environment aligned with your brand. Meanwhile, if you’re a homeowner in Washington, residential custom painting can turn your home into a sanctuary that inspires relaxation or creativity. 
Durability: With professional-grade paints and techniques, custom finishes are often more resistant to everyday wear, keeping your space looking fresh longer. 

You can experience all this and more. All you need to do is contact our team of skilled painters at EA Pro Painters or get a quote from us. 


Our Customized Painting Process: Designed with You in Mind  


We at EA Pro Painters have learned one thing after working with homeowners and business owners in the Greater Seattle Area for years: 




The best results are the result of collaboration. 




With this in mind, we’ve designed a custom painting process that prioritizes your needs. When you work with us, you’ll be involved every step of the way so that the finished product matches (or surpasses) your expectations. 




Here’s a breakdown of what to expect when you choose us.  ﻿

Consultation

The consultation phase begins after you contact us. We’ll be attentive to what you have in mind, whether it’s a painted cabinet or a bespoke painting project for your interiors. 


Get an Estimate


By the time the consultation ends, we will have gathered sufficient information. A team member will then provide you with a free estimate. We offer non-obligatory quotes, so there’s no pressure to decide right away. 


Prep Work


We can begin surface preparations once you approve our quote. This may involve minor carpentry and damage repair, filling gaps, sanding surfaces, moving furniture out of the way, and implementing safety measures to protect you, your family, and your possessions. 


Customized Painting﻿

With our skilled team and top-quality materials, we apply the paint with precision. From hand-painted details to durable, even coatings, your vision will be brought to life as our team pays attention to every stroke and detail. 

The Finishing Touches


Once the painting is complete, we add any final touches and inspect the work to ensure a high-quality result. At EA Pro Painters, the job is not done until you’re delighted with the outcome. 


Types of Custom Painting Services We Offer  


As trusted custom painting professionals in the Greater Seattle Area, we’re your one-stop shop for a range of services. We offer a comprehensive suite of exceptional services, from interior painting to drywall. 




Choose from our offerings and say hello to revamped and revitalized surfaces for your business or property. 




Interior Painting 




Interior painting services can completely refresh the look and feel of your indoor spaces. Our comprehensive interior painting services are designed to meet individual client needs, ensuring a customized approach for every project. We’re dedicated to helping you find colors that align with your tastes and purposes. 




For rooms needing a calming ambiance or spaces that thrive with vibrant energy, we curate finishes and hues that complement the room’s light and design. From cozy living rooms to productive office spaces, every interior project becomes a personalized statement. 




Exterior Painting 




Washington’s climate can do a number on your exterior surfaces; this is where our exterior painting services come in. 




Our team highlights your home’s architectural character using premium weather-resistant paints while ensuring long-lasting curb appeal. Every exterior project is approached with aesthetics and durability in mind, so your home remains welcoming and protected, season after season. 



Cabinet Painting 




Instead of a remodel, a cabinet makeover is a more cost-effective way to bring new life to your kitchen or bathroom. Our cabinet painting service combines precision with creativity, starting with surface prep and ending in flawless application. 




Various color palettes are also available, so you can select shades that refresh your space while seamlessly complementing your existing decor. Whether you want a modern finish or a classic look, our work helps make every cabinet a statement piece. 




Commercial Painting 




Our commercial painting service is adaptable and designed to fit various industries and reflect your brand’s unique style. From bright and welcoming storefronts to sophisticated office interiors, we consider the high-traffic nature of your commercial space and apply durable, easy-to-maintain finishes. 




Each project is crafted to meet your goals, so we align the look of your space with your brand’s values and aesthetic. 




Millwork Painting 




Do you want work done on your property’s moldings, trim, or other architectural features? If you do, you need a professional. 




Our millwork painting focuses on enhancing your home or business’s design elements. By offering custom finishes, we ensure these details either blend flawlessly with your walls or provide a contrasting accent that highlights your interior design. 




Deck and Fence Painting 




Decks and fences are exposed to the outdoors year-round, so they need aesthetic and functional protection. When you contact us for our deck and fence painting services, we start by preparing the surfaces to remove debris or old finishes. Then, we apply weather-resistant paint to keep your outdoor spaces looking vibrant and new. 




These finishing touches on decks and fences protect your wood and metal from deterioration. Trust us to extend their lifespan and keep your spaces inviting. 

﻿

Drywall Services 




Dry and smooth walls are the foundation of a clean and professional paint job, and this is what you can look forward to with our custom drywall services. 




Our drywall services cover everything from minor repairs to complete wall preparation, removing imperfections for a flawless finish. Whether you need patching, sanding, or a complete re-surfacing, our approach sets up your walls to ensure each coat of paint appears crisp and polished. 




Why Choose EA Pro Painters?  


Choosing the right professional painting contractors can make all the difference in your project. Here’s why Washington clients trust us: 


Local Expertise  


We’ve served businesses and homeowners in the Greater Seattle Area for years. Our experience with the region’s local climate enables us to select the best paints and apply precision techniques to ensure that your surfaces stay pristine for the long haul. 


Precision Painting Techniques  

Precise paint application has been our company’s signature, so each project we take on is completed with attention to detail. From preparing your surfaces to the finishing touches, we ensure that every aspect of your custom project meets and exceeds your expectations. 

Check Out Our Extensive Project Portfolio  


The proof is in the pudding, which is why we at EA Pro Painters have amassed an extensive portfolio of satisfied customers and past projects. Check out our project portfolio and see what artistry and precision await when you choose our team.

 What Is Millwork Painting?  
 Millwork might sound like a historic piece of furniture, but it’s a common decorative piece almost every house has. In a nutshell, millwork is any decorative material made from wood-mill. This includes window trims, door trims, moldings, baseboards, cabinetries, stairways, wainscoting, and so on. Painting your millwork can subtly infuse your home or commercial property with a pop of color or create a seamless transition between rooms. High-quality paint also protects these classic decorative wood pieces and keeps them strong for years to come. A professional painting contractor can play a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing your millwork, ensuring it stays beautiful and durable.  
 Benefits of Millwork Painting   
 It’s not uncommon for homeowners to neglect their millwork — or at least some of their millwork. It’s not always a priority to update your door frames or wainscoting. Keeping your millwork fresh with new coats of paint, however, is crucial for several reasons:  
 Interior Enhancement: 
 The most evident reason would be to keep your interior looking good. Millwork materials are functional and decorative, so it makes sense to keep them looking pretty.  
 Protection and Durability: 
 Applying a fresh coat of paint protects your millwork from the elements and conditions inside your home and extends its lifespan.  
 Increase Property Value: 
 Every slight improvement you invest in your house raises your home’s property value.  
 Our Millwork Painting Process  
 Working with an experienced and talented interior painter ensures high-quality output, minimal downtime, and more time for you to focus on other important areas of your life. Our millwork painting experts at EA Pro employ a thorough millwork painting process to guarantee your satisfaction with our work. Here’s what you can expect when you work with us:  Get Your Free Estimate: Start your process by requesting a free millwork painting estimate. A team member will be in touch to discuss more of your project and if we’re the right fit. Color Consultation and Assessment: During this phase, our millwork painting experts will help you figure out the right color scheme for your project. We’ll consider your budget, millwork piece(s), personal taste, and other crucial design and practical factors. Start Project: It’s time to get to work after the planning stage. We’ll do our best to complete the project within the estimated timeline and minimize disruptions. Quality Inspection & Warranty: Just because it looks pretty doesn’t mean it’s perfect. We employ a 50-point quality inspection after every painting project to make sure no spots are left unpainted. We also guarantee a four-year warranty for all our finished work. Additionally, EA Pro Painters comply with all local regulations and certifications in Washington state, ensuring professional and safe services.  
Our comprehensive millwork painting services cover all your needs before, during, and after the painting project. We ensure that you’re informed, engaged, and satisfied. We streamline our process so you can easily track what’s happening and plan ahead.  Why Choose EA Pro Painting for Millwork Painting?  
Our team has helped enrich countless houses and commercial properties in Bellevue, WA, with eye-catching colors and satin-sleek paint applications. If you’re looking for a reputable paint company in the area, here are some reasons why we’re your best pick. EA Pro Painters can handle comprehensive painting projects, including the entire house.  Affordable  
Affordable doesn’t mean disappointing results. Our affordable price point might deter you from subscribing to our millwork painting services, but we guarantee the lavish quality you get when you pay for more expensive services.  
At EA Pro Painters, we provide exceptional value without compromising on quality. Our pricing is intended to accommodate the different budgets of property owners in the area. We want to give you access to high-quality work without exhausting your budget.  Skilled Craftsmanship  
Our experienced millwork painting experts bring a high level of expertise to every project. Our team focuses intently on the intricate details of millwork, from color selection and precise application to securing a flawless finish that will last you for years.  
With years of experience, our painters have developed a sharp eye for detail to deliver flawless results that elevate the beauty of your space.  Use of Premium Products  
Not all paint is created equal, and some formulations might not be suitable for your millwork. Choosing the right paint is crucial to ensuring both durability and aesthetic appeal. At EA Pro Painting, we select high-quality, premium paints specifically formulated to adhere to millwork surfaces. These paints provide excellent coverage, resist wear and tear, and keep their vibrant colors over time. We want you to get the best value for your money.  Attention to Detail  
Our strict quality guidelines enforce a system that ensures each project meets our lofty standards before completion. Throughout the project, our supervisors are on-site to oversee every aspect, from preparation to the finishing touches. We implement regular checks at each stage to make sure no detail is overlooked.  
Our dedication to quality guarantees that the result exceeds your expectations. We want you to feel completely satisfied with the transformation we bring to your home or business.  Commitment to Customer Satisfaction  
Our company has served the local community for over five years with a steadfast commitment to customer satisfaction. When you work with our team, we take the time to understand your specific needs and vision. Our goal is to make each project uniquely tailored to reflect what you want to see in your home. Your satisfaction is our ultimate goal, driving us to deliver consistent excellence in all aspects of our service.  We Paint All Types of Millworks  
Our comprehensive millwork painting services cover all bases, so you won’t have to worry about finding multiple contractors for different parts of your project. Whether you need us to paint doors, trims, baseboards, cabinets, or crown molding, we have the ability and resources to handle it all.

Trims

Wainscoting  
Chair Rails  
Built-In Shelving

From choosing the perfect shade to achieve a cohesive look throughout your space to ensuring that each painted surface is durable and long-lasting, our team is dedicated to bringing your vision to life.  Residential and Commercial Painting Solutions  
At EA Pro Painters, we understand the importance of a well-maintained residential or commercial property. Our interior and exterior painting services enhance the appearance and durability of your building while ensuring a safe and healthy environment for your family, employees, and customers. Our team of professional painters has extensive experience providing high-quality residential and commercial painting services, including exterior painting, interior painting, and painting millwork. We use only the highest-quality paints and materials, and our team is trained to work efficiently and effectively to minimize disruption to your home or business. Whether you need a fresh coat of paint for your entire building or just a few touch-ups, we can help with the entire process. Our painting services include:  Exterior Painting: We can paint your home or building’s exterior, including walls, trim, and doors, to protect it from the elements and enhance its appearance. Interior Painting: Our team can paint the interior of your residence or office, including the walls, ceilings, cabinetry, and trim, to create a fresh and welcoming environment. Painting Millwork: We can paint your millwork, including doors, windows, and trim, to match your desired color and style.  
Our wide range of services ensure your property looks its best and stands out in the competitive market—Trust EA Pro Painters to deliver a fantastic job every time.  Our Credentials  
At EA Pro Painters, we are proud of the reputation we have built in the Seattle area. Here are some of our finer points:  Locally Owned and Operated: We are a locally owned and operated business, which means we are committed to serving our community and providing the best possible residential painting and commercial service to our customers. Licensed and Insured: We are fully licensed and insured, which means you can trust us to do the paint job right and protect your property. Experienced Team: Our team of skilled painters has extensive experience providing high-quality painting services, including commercial, exterior, and interior painting. Fantastic Job: We have a reputation for doing a tremendous job and providing excellent customer satisfaction. Our customers rave about our high-quality work and our commitment to customer service.  
Our dedication to excellence and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted name in the Seattle area. When you choose EA Pro Painters, you can be confident that you are working with a team that values quality and professionalism.  Painting Prep & Repair  
At EA Pro Painters, we understand that painting is not just about applying paint to a surface. It’s about preparing the surface properly and repairing any damage before painting. Our team of experienced painters is trained to provide expert painting prep and repair services, including:  Surface Preparation: We can prepare your surface for painting by cleaning, sanding, and filling any holes or cracks. Repairing Damage: We can repair carpentry for any damage to your walls, ceilings, or trim, including holes, cracks, and water damage. Finishing Millwork: We can finish your millwork, including doors, windows, and trim, to match your desired color and style. Kitchen Cabinets: We can refinish your cabinets to give them a fresh look and protect them from wear and tear.  
By providing expert painting prep and repair services, we can ensure that your painting project turns out perfectly and lasts for years to come. Trust EA Pro Painters to deliver high-quality work that enhances the beauty and durability of your property.  Check Out Our Past Work  
We can claim we’re the best all day, but you still won’t buy it. We get it, and we understand. A single picture is worth a thousand words, so we want you to see how we transformed these properties for yourself. 
Explore our extensive portfolio of successful painting projects here!

 Drywall Painting  
The right painting job is more important than you think. Your drywall is a foundation of interior design, helping to set the mood and ambiance of a space, and the paint you choose can make all the difference. At EA Pro Painters, we’re here to help property owners in the Greater Seattle Area achieve the perfect colors and atmosphere with complete drywall services for commercial or residential painting. Our team of professional painters will define expert terms, source top-notch materials, and use tried-and-tested techniques, we can paint drywall to fit your vision or brand messaging. Contact us to schedule an initial consultation!   
 Get A Free Estimate 
 Our Complete Drywall Painting Services   
 Drywall painting is more than just applying a fresh coat of paint to panels. Our service includes specific services like the following.  
 ﻿Custom Drywall Painting   
 Let’s turn your vision into reality with our custom drywall painting solutions. We work closely with you to create dry and smooth walls that serve as the foundation for your design goals. With our guidance, you can choose colorways that create a clean and modern look or something more creative, like bold and vibrant paneling.   
 Minor Drywall Repairs 
 Did the kids use markers that are hard to remove? Are dents or cracks appearing because of regular wear and tear? Even these minor issues can be glaring, decreasing the aesthetic appeal of your drywall. We can work to address these problems and restore the look of your drywall.   
 Complete Wall Preparation   
 A well-prepared surface is key to a smooth coat, allowing the paint to adhere more completely to the surface and reducing the chances of peeling or cracks. With our complete wall preparation services, you can expect flawless and long-lasting results.   
 Patching   
 Physical impact, water damage, and pest infestations can result in holes or gaps in your drywall. Once you’ve addressed the root cause of these issues, we can come in to patch the drywall and return it to its pristine state. Trust that we will seamlessly blend the surrounding surface for an even and polished result.  
 Sanding   
 Our sanding services ensure that every rough surface will be even and smooth before painting.  We work on repaired areas, rough patches, and other sections that have lost their original smoothness or developed imperfections.  
 Complete Resurfacing   
 Some walls are too damaged for minor repairs or sanding. In this case, we offer complete resurfacing services to refresh the panels and remove visible signs of damage.   
 Custom Finishes  
 Our team offers a variety of custom finishes based on your preferences including matte, satin, or textured looks. With these unique finishes, you can elevate the aesthetic of your interiors.  
 Why Work with Drywall Painting Experts for Your Project?   
 Drywall painting may sound like something you can DIY. After all, you’re just applying coats of paint over a surface. However, this process can be complex, and small mistakes could result in added expenses. Here’s why it’s better to work with experts like EA Pro Painters.   
 Professional Service and Results   
 DIY painters won’t have the same skills and techniques as those who have years of experience under their belt. The lack of knowledge can result in lots of missed steps, such as proper surface preparation. The finished results may also have lots of imperfections like visible brush strokes or debris stuck to the paint. You can avoid these issues by working with professionals who have extensive training.  
 Access to the Right Paints and High-tech Equipment   
 Using high-quality pigments and painting equipment is more than just for aesthetics. Good-quality materials can provide protection from the weather and environmental conditions. The right type of paint helps the drywall resist excess moisture, mold, and even pest infestations, making it well worth the extra cost in many circumstances.  
 Cost-efficiency   
 DIY attempts can result in missed areas or paint that starts to crack and peel within a few months resulting in extra cost and time on your part to fix the issues. Working with a professional helps you avoid additional headaches. We do things right the first time, and we provide touchups for free, so you never have to worry about these issues.  
 More Time for Important Matters   
 Time saving is especially important for business owners. Painting your 
commercial property on your own can lead to disrupted operations and loss of income. Instead of DIYing the painting project, let pros like us do it for you. That way, you can focus on more productive aspects of your business and keep your customers happy.  
 Warranty for Peace of Mind 
 Professional painting contractors include a warranty on every project. This guarantee is not just a mark of our confidence in our work. With this warranty, you get peace of mind knowing that even if there are issues down the road, you can count on us to return and address them for you at no additional charge.  
 Improved Property Values 
 Working with professionals for painting projects is one way to increase your property’s value, especially if you’re considering selling it in the future. As experts in the local real estate market, we can suggest color schemes for the drywall that appeal the most to buyers.   
 Choose EA Pro Painters for Drywall Painting Needs   
 EA Pro Painters is your established painting company based in Bellevue, WA. We offer 
an array of resources, from interior and 
exterior painting services to custom painting and paint removal. When you work with us for drywall painting projects, you can expect the following benefits.  
 Local Knowledge: We’re a homegrown company that understands the local environment and climate conditions. This knowledge allows us to provide solutions that can endure the common environmental issues of the Greater Seattle Area. Plus, our local knowledge helps us provide advice on architectural trends, resulting in projects that follow the aesthetics of the localities while maintaining your unique personality.  
Dedicated and Experienced Experts: Each of our team members has extensive knowledge of various painting techniques, materials, and the painting process. We’re all dedicated to the craft, resulting in attention to detail that is second to none. Additionally, our team undergoes continuous training to remain knowledgeable in the latest painting trends and innovations.   
Recognized in the Region: In recognition of our expert work, bodies like the ThreeBestRated have cited us as one of the top painting contractors in Bellevue. We also have a stellar track record of satisfied clients, serving as proof of our quality services.  
Warranty for All Projects: All our painting projects come with a warranty for your peace of mind. If you find any sections or areas with issues, count on us to come to your property and address the problem at no added charge.  
Licensed and Insured: We’re a licensed contractor that adheres to local and state laws. Plus, our team is insured to protect our clients from financial liability in case accidents or injuries happen during the project.  
 Enjoy Our Streamlined Process  
The most important thing to us is customer satisfaction. Beyond the exceptional drywall painting services, we ensure a top-notch experience for clients with our streamlined process. Here’s how it works.  
 Initial Consultation: Contact us and tell us the details of your project. We’ll come up with a free estimate based on the scope of the job and other factors. This is a no-obligation offer, giving you time to decide on your budget and needs.   
Color Selection: If you accept the initial offer, we can begin the planning stage. Our team of experienced painters will work closely with you, providing guidance on the colorways based on the aesthetic or look you want to achieve. We’ll also plan the schedule and other important considerations for the project.  
Project Execution: Our team will arrive and begin the project precisely on the agreed-upon date. We will communicate with you regularly to ensure that everything is going as planned and that there are minimal disruptions to your operations.  
Final Inspection: Once we finish the final coats, our team will conduct an inspection to assess every area and ensure that no spot is left unpainted. We’ll do any touchups before issuing the warranty details.  
 Book a Consultation with Us  
Our professional painting services are the pinnacle of precision and expertise. From surface preparation to finishing touches, we meticulously address drywall imperfections, ensuring smooth and immaculate walls that serve as the perfect canvas for refined interior designs. Let our team help you achieve the look you’ve always wanted for your residential or commercial property. Contact us now to get your free estimate!

mainEntity.name: Does my HOA have to approve my exterior paint color?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most Eastside communities with an active association, yes. Governing documents commonly require architectural review committee approval before exterior painting, and many maintain an approved palette you must select from. Painting without approval is a genuine risk, not a technicality. Associations can require repainting at the owner's expense, and in Washington they may have lien authority for unpaid assessments and fines. Check your CC&Rs before you choose a color — and if you cannot find them, the association or management company is required to provide them. We routinely prepare the color samples and documentation review committees ask for.

mainEntity.name: How often does an HOA make you repaint your house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Eastside associations expect exteriors to be maintained on roughly a 7 to 12 year cycle, though few specify a fixed interval. The more common standard is condition-based: governing documents require owners to maintain exteriors in good repair, and the association issues a notice when a home visibly falls below that. That means the trigger is usually a violation notice rather than a date. Peeling, chalking, faded elevations, or exposed wood are what prompt them. If you have received a notice with a compliance deadline, tell us — we schedule around association deadlines regularly and can prioritize accordingly.

mainEntity.name: Do you work directly with HOA boards and property managers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A substantial share of our commercial work is association projects across Bellevue, Bothell, Issaquah, Redmond, and Sammamish — single buildings through multi-building communities. We provide what boards actually need to make a decision and defend it to owners: a written scope with specified products and preparation sequence, itemized per-building or per-phase pricing, a schedule with milestones, certificates of insurance naming the association, and a single point of contact. We are also willing to present the scope at a board or owners meeting, which frequently matters more to approval than the bid itself. We do informative presentations to HOAs/homeowners including step-by-step, day by day expectations, so everyone knows what to expect from the process.

mainEntity.name: How do you price a multi-building community project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per building and per phase rather – or one lump sum if requested – so the board can see exactly what each element costs and phase the work across budget years if reserves require it. Most communities we work with do not paint everything in one season. A common structure is a three-year rotation — one third of the buildings each year — which smooths the reserve draw and keeps the whole community on a consistent cycle. If needed, we can do it all at once. We are glad to build the scope either way and let the board decide with real numbers in front of them.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed, bonded, and insured to the level our association requires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We carry Washington L&I registration, a surety bond, general liability, and workers' compensation, and we issue certificates naming the association as additional insured. For association work specifically, verify workers' compensation on every bid you receive. If an uninsured contractor's worker is injured on common property, the exposure can reach the association and, through it, the owners. Send us your insurance requirements with the RFP and we will confirm compliance before bidding rather than after award.

 Kirkland: About the Town  
 Kirkland: A Waterfront Town Blending Nature, History, and Innovation  
﻿Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Washington, Kirkland, Washington, is a vibrant city offering a captivating blend of waterfront beauty, rich history, and modern innovation. With a population of over 92,000 residents, Kirkland is the sixth-largest city in King County.  A Rich Tapestry of History and Culture  
Kirkland was founded in the late 1880s as a small farming community. The city was named after Peter Kirkland, a prominent early settler. Over the years, Kirkland has transformed into a thriving city while preserving its historical charm, evident in its well-preserved buildings and cultural landmarks. The Kirkland Historical Society and the Kirkland Heritage Society are dedicated to keeping the city's history alive through exhibits, events, and educational programs.  A Haven for Outdoor Enthusiasts  
Kirkland's waterfront location and surrounding natural beauty provide ample opportunities for outdoor recreation. Our city boasts over 25 parks and trails, catering to a variety of interests and skill levels.  Waterfront Activities: Enjoy swimming, kayaking, paddleboarding, and other water sports at Kirkland's public beaches, including Kirkland Marina Park and Houghton Beach Park. The Kirkland Trail: This scenic 6.5-mile trail offers stunning views of Lake Washington and connects many of the city's parks and green spaces, perfect for walking, running, or biking. Bridle Trails State Park: Located just outside the city limits, this expansive park offers hiking, biking, and horseback riding opportunities amidst scenic forests and meadows.  
 A Hub for Innovation and Business  
The city is home to a diverse range of companies, from established technology giants like Google and Amazon to startups and small businesses. This dynamic environment fosters creativity and economic growth, attracting professionals from various industries. Experience the Magic of Kirkland Kirkland offers an exceptional quality of life, blending breathtaking natural scenery with a rich cultural heritage, a vibrant arts scene, and a thriving job market. With many outdoor adventures, cultural experiences, and a family-friendly community, Kirkland has something to offer everyone.

Kirkland: A Waterfront Town Blending Nature, History, and Innovation

Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Washington, Kirkland, Washington, is a vibrant city offering a captivating blend of waterfront beauty, rich history, and modern innovation. With a population of over 92,000 residents, Kirkland is the sixth-largest city in King County. 




A Rich Tapestry of History and Culture 




Kirkland was founded in the late 1880s as a small farming community. The city was named after Peter Kirkland, a prominent early settler. Over the years, Kirkland has transformed into a thriving city while preserving its historical charm, evident in its well-preserved buildings and cultural landmarks. The Kirkland Historical Society and the Kirkland Heritage Society are dedicated to keeping the city's history alive through exhibits, events, and educational programs. 




A Haven for Outdoor Enthusiasts 




Kirkland's waterfront location and surrounding natural beauty provide ample opportunities for outdoor recreation. Our city boasts over 25 parks and trails, catering to a variety of interests and skill levels. 

Waterfront Activities: Enjoy swimming, kayaking, paddleboarding, and other water sports at Kirkland's public beaches, including Kirkland Marina Park and Houghton Beach Park. 
The Kirkland Trail: This scenic 6.5-mile trail offers stunning views of Lake Washington and connects many of the city's parks and green spaces, perfect for walking, running, or biking. 
Bridle Trails State Park: Located just outside the city limits, this expansive park offers hiking, biking, and horseback riding opportunities amidst scenic forests and meadows. 




A Hub for Innovation and Business 



The city is home to a diverse range of companies, from established technology giants like Google and Amazon to startups and small businesses. This dynamic environment fosters creativity and economic growth, attracting professionals from various industries. 

Experience the Magic of Kirkland 

Kirkland offers an exceptional quality of life, blending breathtaking natural scenery with a rich cultural heritage, a vibrant arts scene, and a thriving job market. With many outdoor adventures, cultural experiences, and a family-friendly community, Kirkland has something to offer everyone.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint a house in Bellevue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bellevue exteriors typically run $5,000 to $12,000 and interiors $3,500 to $25,000. Bellevue spans an unusually wide range of housing — a Crossroads rambler and a Somerset or Bridle Trails custom home are not the same project, and an honest estimate reflects that rather than applying a flat per-square-foot rate. What actually drives the number: the condition of the existing coating, the siding material, the number of stories, the amount of trim and detail work, and how much carpentry repair surfaces once we start washing. We itemize all of it so you can see what you are paying for and adjust scope if you want to.

mainEntity.name: Can I see paint colors in person before I commit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — and this is genuinely unusual for a painting contractor. Our Bellevue location at 3700 Factoria Blvd SE is next door to Sherwin-Williams. You can sit down with us, talk through the project, then walk next door and look at real samples under real light. Colors that look right on a phone screen frequently look wrong on a wall. North-facing Pacific Northwest rooms pull cool and grey in ways that surprise people, and an exterior color chosen indoors often reads two shades darker outside under overcast sky. Seeing large samples in person, and living with them on the actual wall for a couple of days, prevents the most expensive mistake in painting: repainting.

mainEntity.name: Do Bellevue HOAs restrict what colors I can use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many do. Somerset, Newport Hills, Lakemont, and a number of the Bridle Trails and Woodridge communities maintain approved palettes and require architectural review before exterior work begins. We work inside these constraints routinely — pulling compliant color options, preparing the sample boards committees ask for, and scheduling around approval timelines that typically run two to four weeks. If you are not sure whether your community has a review requirement, we can usually tell you during the walkthrough.

mainEntity.name: How often should a Bellevue home be repainted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exteriors generally need attention every 7 to 12 years here, though south and west elevations often need it sooner than the rest of the house. Interiors depend entirely on use — high-traffic areas every 3 to 5 years, low-traffic rooms considerably longer. Do not wait for a calendar date. Chalking that comes off on your hand, hairline cracking, caulk pulling away from trim joints, or any bare wood showing means the coating has stopped protecting the substrate. Repainting at that point is maintenance. Waiting past it turns it into carpentry, which costs several times more.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — licensed with Washington L&I, bonded, and carrying full liability and workers' compensation coverage. Our registration number and certificate of insurance come with every estimate as a matter of course. Workers' compensation is the one homeowners most often overlook. If an uninsured contractor's employee is injured on your property, exposure can land on your homeowner's policy. Verifying coverage takes two minutes on the L&I website and is worth doing for every bid you receive, including ours.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a painting company and a painting contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: In practice the terms are used interchangeably, but there is a real distinction worth understanding. A licensed painting contractor is registered with Washington L&I, bonded, and insured, and is legally able to take responsibility for the work. "Painting company" is a business description with no regulatory meaning — anyone can use it. The question to ask is not which label a business uses but whether they can produce a current L&I registration number, an active bond, and a certificate of insurance naming your property. We provide all three with every estimate.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint a house in Bothell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bothell exteriors generally run $4,000 to $9,000 and interiors $3,000 to $25,000. Much of Bothell — particularly around Canyon Park and North Creek — is newer construction with fiber cement or engineered siding, which prepares faster and prices lower than the cedar common in older Eastside neighborhoods. Homes in the older core near Main Street are a different calculation. Wood siding, more complex trim detail, and decades of accumulated coating layers mean prep drives the price more than square footage does.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle commercial painting in Bothell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with commercial property owners, managers, and HOA boards throughout the Bothell and Canyon Park corridor — office suites, retail spaces, multi-family buildings, and common areas. Commercial work is scheduled around your operations rather than ours. Most interior commercial projects run evenings and weekends so tenants and customers are not working around drop cloths, and we phase multi-unit exteriors so parking and access stay usable throughout.

mainEntity.name: How soon can you start a project in Bothell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior work can usually begin within one to two weeks year-round. Exterior scheduling depends on the season — May through October books heavily, and by June we are commonly scheduling one to two weeks out. Depending on the situation we may be able to start work in one to two business days if it needs to be done right away. If you are planning exterior work for next summer, the useful move is to get the estimate done in late winter. Estimates are free and do not expire in a way that pressures you, and it puts you at the front of the calendar rather than the back. If you get an estimate before Spring, you are able to get better pricing.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our workmanship warranty covers peeling, blistering, and premature coating failure attributable to preparation or application. It is provided in writing with the contract rather than promised verbally. Worth understanding: a workmanship warranty and a manufacturer's product warranty are different things, and a contractor who blurs them is telling you something. Ask any bidder to put the term, what is covered, and what voids it on paper before you sign.

Bothell's history stretches back to the late 19th century, when it was established as a lumber town. It is said the city was founded in 1870 by Henry C. Bothell, a Norwegian immigrant. However, the city's name is derived from "Boethal," a misspelling of "Bethel," which was the name chosen by early settlers who hailed from Bethel, Vermont. Over the years, Bothell has transformed from a logging center into a hub for technology and manufacturing, while still preserving its historical charm.  A Hub for Technology and Innovation  
Bothell has emerged as a major center for technology and innovation. The city is home to numerous high-tech companies, including Boeing, Roche, and FTEK, fostering a dynamic environment that attracts skilled professionals from various industries. Additionally, Bothell actively supports startups and entrepreneurs, making it a hub for creativity and groundbreaking ideas.  A Haven for Outdoor Enthusiasts

The city is surrounded by lush greenery and scenic trails, providing residents with an escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.  Sammamish River Trail: This scenic trail, winding its way through Bothell, offers opportunities for walking, jogging, biking, and enjoying the beauty of the Sammamish River. Bothell Marsh Park: This 180-acre park features a boardwalk, nature trails, and a variety of birdwatching opportunities. North Creek Park: This park encompasses over 600 acres of forests, wetlands, and meadows, providing a haven for hiking, picnicking, and exploring nature.

Bothell's history stretches back to the late 19th century, when it was established as a lumber town. It is said the city was founded in 1870 by Henry C. Bothell, a Norwegian immigrant. mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to paint a house in Issaquah?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Issaquah exterior repaints land between $4,500 and $9,500, and interiors between $3,200 and $30,000. The spread is wide because Issaquah housing stock is varied: a 1,400 sq ft bungalow in Olde Town prices very differently from a 4,000 sq ft home in Issaquah Highlands. Three things move the number most. Cedar siding - common on older Issaquah homes - needs more prep than fiber cement and often needs spot replacement before paint. Two-story elevations on sloped lots require staging that flat lots do not. And how much of the existing paint is failing matters more than square footage: a sound surface needs washing and priming, while a chalking or peeling one needs scraping and sealing first. We give a firm, itemized number after walking the property. No estimate, no charge, no pressure.

mainEntity.name: Do I need HOA approval to repaint my home in Issaquah Highlands or Talus?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually yes if you’re changing the color. Issaquah Highlands and Talus both maintain active architectural review processes with approved color palettes, and most require written approval before exterior work begins. Approval timelines commonly run two to four weeks. We handle this regularly. We can pull colors that fall inside your community's approved palette, prepare the color samples your architectural committee needs to review, and schedule the work around the approval date so you are not paying for a crew to wait.

mainEntity.name: Are painters required to be licensed in Washington State?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Washington requires painting contractors to register with the Department of Labor & Industries, carry a surety bond, and maintain liability insurance. You can verify any contractor's status, bond, and claim history free on the L&I "Verify a Contractor" tool (https://secure.lni.wa.gov/verify/ ) before you sign anything. EA Pro Painters is licensed, bonded, and insured, and we provide our registration number (EAPROPP7611N) and a certificate of insurance with every estimate. If a contractor hesitates to give you either, that is your answer.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to paint an exterior in Issaquah?

acceptedAnswer.text: May through October is the reliable window. Issaquah sits against the foothills and runs measurably wetter and cooler than Bellevue, so the shoulder seasons are less forgiving here than a few miles west. The requirement is not just "no rain." Surfaces need to stay above about 38°F through the cure, and overnight dew on a fresh coat causes surfactant leaching — the streaky residue people mistake for a bad paint job. We watch dew point, not just the forecast, and we will move a start date rather than paint into a marginal night.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical Issaquah exterior project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two to four working days for most single-family homes, depending on the size of the home. Roughly half of that is preparation — washing, scraping, sanding, caulking, and priming bare spots — which is the part that determines whether the finish lasts eight years or fifteen. Larger homes, heavy cedar restoration, or projects needing significant carpentry repair run longer. We give you a day count in the written estimate, and if weather moves it, you hear from us the same day rather than finding out when nobody shows up.
